item.title: The Christian Chemist Podcast
item.description: The Christian Chemist Podcast explores Seventh Day Adventism through the analytical lens of a chemist. I’m neither a teacher nor a preacher. I’m simply sharing the truths that God has shown me and continues to show me through His Word and complementing it with chemistry when the opportunity arises. The post The Christian Chemist Podcast appeared first on The Christian Chemist.

item.title: God = Love ≈ Acceptance ≠ Tolerance
item.description: God is Love and Love is Acceptance and Acceptance is Tolerance Do you believe all of these statements to be true? If so then this statement - God is Tolerance - is also true. However this statement taken out of context can be detrimental to your salvation. I am going show you how the devil turns God’s truth into a lie that traps God’s people into a false sense of security. The post God = Love ≈ Acceptance ≠ Tolerance appeared first on The Christian Chemist.

item.title: How the Holy Spirit protected me by impairing my hearing
item.description: I have two testimonies to share in this episode that occurred when I was travelling by taxi to church on Sabbath. In both instances I was unable to hear the person's verbal abuse clearly even though I was well within earshot. I honestly believe that it was the Holy Spirit impairing my hearing in order to protect me from both physical and spiritual harm. The post How the Holy Spirit protected me by impairing my hearing appeared first on The Christian Chemist.

item.title: What does no more sacrifice for sins really mean in the book of Hebrews
item.description: Another Christian told me that there’s no more forgiveness of sins. If you get baptized and give your life to Christ and then knowingly sin afterwards you will not be forgiven. And as I’m typing this it looks just as crazy as it sounds. Why someone would think this after reading the book of Hebrews? The post What does no more sacrifice for sins really mean in the book of Hebrews appeared first on The Christian Chemist.

item.title: Sayings that came from the Bible: Am I my brother’s keeper? - The Christian Chemist
item.description: “Am I my brother’s keeper” originated in the Bible and dates as far back as the first 2 children to be born. Nowadays it’s used quite differently.

item.title: Who is Michael the Archangel - The Christian Chemist
item.description: Knowing the true identity of Michael the Archangel changes the entire meaning of the season finale of the Lucifer Netflix series show.

item.title: The Word according to Matthew 24-25 for February 24-25, 2022

item.title: How can Santeria exist if Mary is indeed with the saints in heaven? - The Christian Chemist
item.description: What does the Virgin Mary, mother of God, (Santa Maria) and Santeria have in common? How are the 2 connected? In more ways than you think…
